title: Hearty Springy Argentinian Apple Tagine
description: A resinous and springy Argentinian dish featuring apple juice, cooked in a tagine, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian friendly meal. This nostalgic recipe brings together the flavors of Argentina and the warmth of a tagine cook.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the cubed butternut squash and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it starts to soften.
Add the chopped red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the apple juice, quince paste, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the tagine and cook over low heat for 20 minutes, or until the squash is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
